title: Lock Chicago - Escape Room Games
specs: Escape rooms are fully private for your group.
Rooms and building designed to be accessible and suitable for guests using mobility aids.
Free parking in front of the building; additional street parking nearby.
Entrance is a 1-minute walk from Central St. Purple Line stop and across from Central Street Metra Station.
All participants must sign an online waiver. Guests under 18 need parent/guardian signature.
Guests under 13 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian inside the room.
Children under 5 join for free with family/group; all players age 5+ require a ticket.
Minimum 2 tickets required per room. Every participant must have a ticket.

includes: All experiences are private; your group is never paired with strangers.
Secure lockers for bags, purses, and personal items.
blurb: Lock Chicago offers themed escape room experiences where participants solve puzzles and complete story-driven missions as a group. Each room is private and designed to challenge teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving skills. There are three different rooms—Kong, The Thieves Den, and Icarus—each with unique objectives.
extraNote: All bookings are final. · All participants must arrive on time; late arrivals may not be admitted, or may get less than 60 minutes. · Anyone deemed impaired will be asked to leave without a refund. · Entrance directly off Green Bay Road, across from the Central Street Metra Station.
